text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE — High 502 rate on apigw-prod-eu-west (5m avg 18%). Links: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abcd/apigw-latency; pager: #oncall

alice: Acknowledged. Jumping in. Are we seeing origin 502 or front-proxy?

bob: Origin 502s from model-ingress pool (ingress-ml-1..3). Upstream 5xx spikes line up with a deployment at 12:13Z.

carol: Confirmed — k8s rollout for model-serving v2 at 12:12Z. Health checks failing -> envoy 502s. Pod restarts visible.

alice: Good catch. Rollback candidate? Who owns the rollout?

dave: I triggered the rollout. Logs show startup timeout on post-config-hook: "timeout waiting for cache". Sample error:
```
ERROR main: failed to warm kv cache: timeout after 30s
...
```

alice: Ok, plan: 1) Pause rollout / scale down new replica set 2) Route traffic away from ingress-ml nodes via mux rule 3) Enable fast-failback to model-v1. Volunteers?

bob: I can flip mux rule. Doing a quick traffic-shift to fallback pool (10% -> 0) then full 100% fallback.

carol: Scaling down new RS now: `kubectl -n ml scale rs model-v2-rc --replicas=0` — applied.

opsbot: Action logged: scale replica set model-v2-rc -> 0 by carol at 1765439958

bob: Traffic shift started — updating routing weights. Monitoring error rate.

alice: Also disabling health-check strictness temporarily so older pods don't get pulled. `set-config apigw health.strict=false`

pm_jen: Heads-up: customers in EU may see degraded requests for ~5-10m, ticket being opened.

bob: Error rate dropping: 18% -> 4% in 2m. Latency back to baseline. :thumbsup:

alice: Great. Leave the RS scaled to 0. We'll schedule a postmortem with model team and devs to fix startup warmers and increase readiness probe timeouts.

dave: I'll push a hotfix branch to increase readinessProbe initialDelaySeconds and add cache retry with backoff.

carol: Marking incident mitigated. Moving to monitoring. Oncall handoff in 20m to @bob.

alice: Handoff acknowledged. @bob you own the follow-ups (postmortem + release checklist).

bob: Acknowledged. Will create incident doc and link alerts -> https://confluence.redwood.example/display/INC/APIGW+502+Spike+1765439876

alice: Closing thread for active mitigation. Keep me posted if any regressions. :white_check_mark:
